items.title: Realty Income Stock And Other Tax Efficient Dividend Picks For US Income Investors
items.summary: U.S. debt just passed US$40b and talk of new wealth and asset taxes is no longer a fringe idea; it is in the policy conversation. That kind of debate can reshape how income portfolios work, since what you keep after tax matters as much as what you earn before it. This article unpacks the fiscal story and then walks through 3 dividend stocks from the screener that appear closely exposed to this shift. The three dividend picks below are only a starting sample from this idea, and the full screen...

items.title: A 70-Year-Old With $500,000 Can Get Paid Every Month by These 4 Dividend Stocks
items.summary: When the paychecks stop but the bills keep landing monthly, a retiree needs income that arrives on the same schedule. Four monthly payers promise to cover it, yet one shared weakness could hit them all at once.

items.title: 10-Year TIPS Pay 2.77% Above Inflation. Here’s How Dividend Stocks Compare

items.title: 4 Dividend Stocks Yielding Over 4% That Retirees Can Grow Tax-Free in a Roth IRA
items.summary: A $500,000 income portfolio can quietly hand the IRS thousands of dollars every year, and one of these four high-yield payers is far more exposed than the rest. Find out which stock belongs in a Roth first and why the gap compounds.
